title: Cached forecast
outcome: Forecasts stay under 60 provider calls a minute.

criteria.behavior: A second call for the same city within 10 minutes does not reach the provider.

WX-1.1: test:test/forecast.test.js#getForecast caches a city for 10 minutes

challenge.simplest: An in-memory per-city cache in front of one fetch.
failureModes: Several processes each keep their own cache

users.basis: cities looked up per minute at peak, from the product dashboard

capacity.cut80: Yes: the cache itself drops most provider calls.
